serializedLocalizedConversation.mainText: One thing I know for sure, it will be anything but boring here… Landlord: All this time you kept a secret from me?! Britannia: Sexbot? For real? No offense, but aren’t those, like, for virgins? Shanice: She’s not a normal bot! She’s a highly advanced model with intellect and emotions that are indistinguishable from a real person! Britannia: I don’t get it, but sure. Lady Annalie: Why didn’t you tell me sooner?! I wouldn’t mind! Bot: C-Calm down, everyone! Let me explain everything step by step. Mrs. Fisher: What’s a ‘bot’? Bot: Oh, I didn’t expect that I would need to explain literally everything… {{wi}}This might take a while… Bot: It all began when a military truck was speeding down the street next to Mr. Landlord’s apartment complex…
